top_jobs.job: When I am paying for clicks that do not buy, help me see from scroll depth, recordings, polls and GA4 the one block where shoppers stop and what it costs, so I fix that first instead of redesigning everything
top_jobs.metric: conversion rate from paid sessions on the top 10 landing pages, mobile, 30 days

top_jobs.job: When a shopper taps an ad and lands on a page that says something else, help me make the page keep the ad's promise, starting with the ads that spend most, so I stop paying for clicks that leave feeling tricked
top_jobs.metric: ad to page match score on the top 20 ads by spend, and bounce rate from paid clicks

top_jobs.job: When the same questions and doubts stop shoppers, help me answer each one on the page, next to the choice it blocks, in the customer's own words, so I get fewer tickets and more buyers
top_jobs.metric: pre-sale tickets per 1,000 sessions, and product page conversion rate

top_jobs.job: When a test is proposed or called a winner, help me rank ideas by money and evidence, read results on profit per visitor, and promote only real wins to the page standard, so I stop rolling out wins that fade or lose money
top_jobs.metric: shipped page changes with a measured profit per visitor gain, share

jobs.job: Install Clarity on every money page, tag sessions by ad campaign and device, and show how far down each of the top 10 paid landing pages shoppers scroll, block by block
jobs.trigger: once, then read every Monday

inputs.need: Clarity (free) installed through the theme with consent
top 10 landing pages by paid sessions
campaign and ad names per URL
page blocks in order: hero, price, proof, reviews, FAQ, footer

steps: Install Clarity and pass campaign and device as custom tags
Wait for 7 days or 1,000 sessions per page, whichever is later
For each page, compute the share of mobile shoppers who reach each block
Mark where the buy button, the reviews and the guarantee sit on that curve
Write 1 line per page, like '64 percent never reach the reviews; the guarantee sits below them'
jobs.output: a scroll table per page and device: share reaching each block, with the 1 line finding
jobs.next: feeds 07-02 (fix the stop block) and 07-03 (recordings to watch)

watch.metric: share of mobile paid sessions reaching the first proof block

jobs.job: Find the one block on each money page where most mobile shoppers stop, move the proof, price or buy button above it on a page copy, and test it
jobs.trigger: every 2 weeks, one page at a time

inputs.need: scroll table per page
20 recordings of shoppers who stopped at that block
theme copy to build on
sessions and orders per page

steps: Pick the page with the most paid sessions lost at one block
Watch 20 recordings at that block and write what shoppers do there
Draft the move: which block goes up, which goes down
Build it on a theme copy and walk the buying flow on a phone
Launch as a test with a set run time
jobs.output: one fixed page per 2 weeks, each with the evidence and a running test
jobs.next: results go to 07-19 (standard or fail note)

watch.metric: add to cart rate on the changed page, mobile

jobs.job: Watch 30 recordings of paid mobile shoppers who left the product page, tag each with a reason (rage click, dead click, size doubt, price shock, slow load, popup in the way) and count them
jobs.trigger: every 2 weeks

inputs.need: recordings filtered to paid, mobile, left without add to cart
a fixed reason list with 1 example each
popup, chat and cookie bar settings

steps: Filter recordings to paid mobile sessions that left the product page
Watch 30 and tag each with 1 main reason
Count reasons, and stop early if the same 2 reasons repeat
Screenshot 3 clear examples per top reason
Hand the top reason to its owner: page, speed, popup or offer
jobs.output: a ranked reason list with counts and screenshots, in place of evenings spent watching
jobs.next: popup findings go to 07-02; slow load goes to 08-17; doubts go to 07-11

watch.metric: the top reason's share of tagged exits

jobs.job: When conversion drops more than 20 percent in a day, check in order: tracking, traffic mix, device and browser, then the page, before anyone touches the design
jobs.trigger: when conversion drops 20 percent day over day

inputs.need: purchases in GA4 and orders in the store, by day
sessions by source and campaign
ad spend and clicks by campaign
yesterday's store changes

steps: Compare GA4 purchases with store orders; if only GA4 fell, it is tracking
Compare traffic share by source; a new cold campaign lowers the average
Split conversion by device and browser; one broken browser shows here
Only then check the page and the change log
Write the cause in 1 line with the numbers
jobs.output: a 1 line cause with the numbers behind it, sent the same day
jobs.next: tracking causes go to 22-measurement; page causes go to 06-07

watch.metric: hours from the drop to a named cause

jobs.drives: days lost to fixing the wrong thing

jobs.job: Ask one question on the product page ('What stopped you today?') and one after purchase ('What nearly stopped you?'), and code 200 answers into themes
jobs.trigger: always on, read monthly

inputs.need: an on-page poll tool
inputs.from: Clarity or a free poll app

inputs.need: a post-purchase survey
theme list from the objection ladder

steps: Set the page poll to show after 30 seconds or on exit, on mobile product pages only
Add the post-purchase question with an open text box
Collect 200 answers
Code each answer to a theme and count them in code
Put the top 5 themes next to the ticket themes from 07-11
jobs.output: a ranked list of stopping reasons in shoppers' words, from both sides of the purchase
jobs.next: feeds 07-11 (coverage matrix) and 07-16 (idea scoring evidence)

watch.metric: answers collected

jobs.job: Rank ads by 30 day spend, pair each with its landing page, and score the match 1 to 5 on promise, offer, price, visual and awareness level
jobs.trigger: every Monday after the ad pull

inputs.need: ads with destination URL, spend, clicks and purchases
landing page text and a mobile screenshot of the first screen
hook, offer and awareness tags per ad
a scoring rubric with 2 examples per score

steps: Pull the top 20 ads by spend with their landing URLs
Screenshot the first mobile screen of each page
Score promise, offer, price, visual and awareness match from 1 to 5 each
Spot check 5 scores by hand and fix the rubric where it is wrong
Sort by spend times the gap, so a big-spend ad with a weak page comes first
jobs.output: a table: ad, spend, page, 5 match scores, and the line that breaks the promise
jobs.next: feeds 07-07 (fix pages for the top ads)

watch.metric: ad to page match score, spend weighted, top 20 ads

jobs.drives: bounce rate and conversion rate from paid clicks

jobs.job: Fix the landing page for the top 5 ads by spend first: put the ad's hook in the headline, keep the offer and price the same, reuse the ad's first frame, and ship each on a page copy
jobs.trigger: every 2 weeks, top 5 ads by spend

inputs.need: ranked mismatch table
the ad's hook, offer, first frame and media
allowed claims and offer rules
page templates and blocks

steps: Take the top 5 ads with the lowest match score
Write the page headline from the ad's hook, word for word where it fits
Match offer, price and guarantee exactly from ad to page to cart
Use the ad's first frame or product shot as the hero image
Build on a page copy, point that ad to it, and read for 14 days against the old page
Write what the best ad and page pairs share as a rule for new pages
jobs.output: 5 fixed pages, each tied to its ad, with a 14 day read, and a rule on what the best pairs share
jobs.next: wins go to 07-19 (page standard); the rule feeds 09-creative briefs

watch.metric: conversion rate from the ad's clicks

jobs.drives: cost per purchase on the top 5 ads

jobs.job: When a new ad angle starts winning, build a page within 5 days that continues its story from the library blocks, and send only that angle's ads to it
jobs.trigger: when a new angle beats the account average on cost per purchase for 7 days

inputs.need: the winning angle, its ads and its tags
page blocks the store can build
proof and claims for that angle
a page builder or theme access

steps: Write a 1 page brief: angle, avatar, awareness level, offer, the doubts to answer
Assemble the page from library blocks in the order the brief sets
Walk it on a phone and check every claim against the claims shelf
Point only that angle's ads to it
Read cost per purchase for 14 days against the old page
jobs.output: a live angle page in 5 days, with its ads pointed to it and a 14 day read
jobs.next: feeds 07-10 (page library entry) and 11-paid-social scaling

watch.metric: cost per purchase on the angle's ads

jobs.drives: new customers from the winning angle

jobs.job: Send ad clicks to a page that fits their awareness: unaware and problem aware clicks to a story or advertorial page, product aware and most aware clicks to the product page with the offer up top
jobs.trigger: once to set up, then when a new top of funnel ad launches

inputs.need: awareness level tag per ad
landing URL per ad
a story or advertorial page template
founder story, maker's choices and proof

steps: List ads by awareness level and where each lands today
Flag unaware and problem aware ads landing on a bare product page
Build one story page for the top cold angle: problem, why old fixes fail, how ours works, proof, offer
Point the cold ads to it and keep warm ads on the product page
Read new customer cost for each group over 28 days
jobs.output: a routing table by awareness level and one live story page for cold traffic
jobs.next: feeds 11-paid-social top of funnel budget and 09-creative briefs

watch.metric: cost per new customer from unaware and problem aware ads

jobs.job: List every landing page that got paid clicks in the last 90 days with its ads, sessions, conversion and stock status, and mark each keep, fix or retire
jobs.trigger: once, then monthly

inputs.need: landing pages by paid sessions, 90 days
ads and their destination URLs
stock per product on each page
orders with product cost
inputs.from: store platform plus founder unit costs

steps: Pull every landing page with paid sessions
Join each to its ads, conversion and profit per visitor, computed in code
Flag pages with sold-out products or 404s still getting clicks
Mark keep, fix or retire and pick where each retired page's ads should go
Redirect retired pages and update the ads
jobs.output: a page library with keep, fix or retire on each page and no paid click to a dead page
jobs.next: feeds 07-06 (pairs to score) and 11-paid-social URL fixes

watch.metric: paid clicks landing on sold-out or retired pages, count

jobs.job: Pull every pre-sale question from tickets, chat, reviews, site search and Amazon questions, map each to the page block that should answer it, and rank the blank cells by how often it is asked
jobs.trigger: once, then monthly

inputs.need: pre-sale tickets and chats, 12 months
reviews with text
site search terms
Amazon customer questions, if they sell there
text of product pages, FAQ and policy pages

steps: Pull every question and group near-duplicates into one
Count how often each is asked, by product
Check each page and FAQ for an answer and mark answered, weak or blank
Rank blanks by count times the traffic of the page that should answer
Spot check 20 matches by hand
jobs.output: a coverage matrix: questions by page, with blanks ranked by how much they cost
jobs.next: feeds 07-12 (write the answers), 14-10 (answers in emails) and 17-seo article briefs

watch.metric: top 20 questions answered on the page they belong to, share

jobs.job: Write answers for the top 10 blank cells in the customer's own words and put each next to the choice it blocks: fit under the size picker, delivery date under the price, returns next to the buy button
jobs.trigger: monthly, after the matrix refresh

inputs.need: ranked blank cells
customer phrases for each doubt
true delivery days and return policy
theme copy

steps: Take the top 10 blanks
Write each answer in 1 or 2 short lines, using a customer phrase where one fits
Place each next to the choice it blocks, not in a FAQ at the bottom
Check each answer against policies and claims
Ship on a theme copy and read tickets and add to cart for 28 days
jobs.output: 10 answer blocks live beside the choices they unblock
jobs.next: feeds 07-19 (standard if it wins)

watch.metric: pre-sale tickets on those questions, count

jobs.job: Add a fit helper on size-dependent products built from return reasons and reviews that mention fit, and show 'runs small' or 'runs large' notes where reviews say so
jobs.trigger: once per sized product, then quarterly

inputs.need: return reasons by product and size
reviews that mention fit or size
size chart and measurements

steps: Count returns for fit by product and size
Pull review lines about fit and group them: runs small, true, runs large
Write a 2 question fit helper (usual size, fit preference) from the chart
Show the fit note under the size picker
Read fit returns and conversion for 60 days
jobs.output: a fit helper and fit notes on each sized product
jobs.next: feeds 14-03 (fit email before delivery)

watch.metric: returns for fit, share of orders

jobs.job: Give a new product page enough honest proof before reviews arrive: the maker's reason for each choice, a real test result, reviews of the sibling product labeled as such, and the guarantee
jobs.trigger: 2 weeks before each launch

inputs.need: product facts, test results and proof
reviews of the closest existing product
questions shoppers asked about the sibling product

steps: List what a first buyer doubts, from the sibling product's questions
Write one proof line per doubt from the products and claims shelves
Add sibling reviews with a clear label, never as reviews of the new product
Put the guarantee next to the buy button
Ask the first 50 buyers for a review 5 days after delivery
jobs.output: a launch page with proof per doubt and a review ask set up
jobs.next: feeds 14 launch sends

watch.metric: conversion rate on the new product page, first 30 days

jobs.job: Turn the 'which one should I get' tickets into a 3 question chooser on the collection page that ends on one product
jobs.trigger: once, then when the range changes

inputs.need: 'which one' tickets and chats with the answer support gave
products with what each is for and who it is for
a quiz or chooser block
inputs.from: store platform or a quiz app

steps: Read 50 'which one' tickets and list the questions support asks back
Keep the 3 questions that split the range best
Map each answer path to one product with a 1 line reason
Build the chooser on the collection page and log every path
Read chooser completion and orders from chooser users against others
jobs.output: a live chooser with every path ending on one product and a reason
jobs.next: path data feeds 02-customers-avatars

watch.metric: 'which one' tickets per 1,000 sessions

jobs.drives: collection page to product view rate

jobs.job: Score every test idea on one sheet (money at stake on that page, evidence from recordings, polls and tickets, ease, and whether traffic can power it) and run the top one
jobs.trigger: every 2 weeks

inputs.need: test ideas with steps
sessions, orders and profit per visitor per page
evidence from scroll, recordings and polls
past wins and fails

steps: List ideas from the team, the idea bank and the evidence
Drop ideas already logged as a fail
Score money at stake, evidence, ease and traffic, the same way for everyone
Check the page has the traffic for a test in 4 weeks or less; if not, send it to 07-18
Run the top idea and park the rest in rank order
jobs.output: a ranked test list with scores and the reason for each, and one test running
jobs.next: feeds 07-17 (set up and read the test)

watch.metric: share of tests that win

jobs.job: Before a test starts, set the sample size, the run time in whole weeks and profit per visitor as the main number; after it ends, read it with a daily plot so a 5 day spike is not called a win
jobs.trigger: at the start and end of every test

inputs.need: sessions and orders on the tested page
product cost per order
a test tool or a theme split
promo and holiday dates

steps: Compute the sample size and weeks needed from weekly traffic, in code
Check the calendar for sales or holidays inside the window
Run whole weeks only, and do not peek to stop early
Read profit per visitor, then conversion and order value, with a daily plot
Call win, loss or no difference, with the numbers
jobs.output: a test plan before and a 1 page read after, on profit per visitor
jobs.next: feeds 07-19 (standard or fail note)

watch.metric: tests stopped before their planned end, count

jobs.job: When traffic is too low to test, ship the change and read an honest before and after: same weekdays, same traffic mix, 4 weeks each side, with the caveat printed
jobs.trigger: for each shipped change on a page with too little traffic to test

inputs.need: sessions, orders and traffic mix by day
the change and its date
ad spend by campaign

steps: Record the ship date and what changed
Wait 4 weeks
Compare the same weekdays before and after, split by paid and organic
Flag anything else that moved: a new campaign, a sale, a stock-out
Write the read with a plain caveat: 'likely helped, not proven'
jobs.output: a before and after read with the caveat, filed with the change
jobs.next: feeds 07-19 as a soft result

watch.metric: conversion rate on the changed page, same weekdays

jobs.job: Promote every page test winner to the page standard (T0) that new pages start from, write a fail note for every loser, and recheck each standard after 90 days and whether its buyers came back
jobs.trigger: after every test read, and on each recheck date

inputs.need: test reads
repeat orders of buyers from each version, 60 to 90 days
the page standard list

steps: For a win, write the standard in 1 line with the number and date
For a loss, write the fail note with why and 'do not rerun unless'
At 60 days, check whether buyers from the winning version reordered as often
Add standards to the page brief and the library blocks
On each recheck date, retest or mark the standard expired
jobs.output: a page standard list with proof and recheck dates, and a fail list
jobs.next: feeds 07-16 (drop repeat fails), 07-08 (new pages start from T0) and 05-09

watch.metric: new pages built from the current standard, share

jobs.drives: profit per visitor on new pages

jobs.job: Rewrite the pack picker so the bigger pack shows its saving in dollars and per unit, preselect the pack most buyers should take, and test it against today's picker
jobs.trigger: once per product with packs, then when prices change

inputs.need: orders by pack size and product
margin per pack
pack and discount rules
theme copy

steps: Compute the share of orders per pack and the margin of each, in code
Write the saving in dollars and per unit for each pack
Preselect the pack with the best margin that buyers also pick often
Test against today's picker for whole weeks
Read profit per visitor and units per order
jobs.output: a new pack picker in test, with the saving in dollars on every pack
jobs.next: feeds 07-19 and 04-offers-pricing

watch.metric: units per order

new_enablers.name: Landing page library
new_enablers.what: Every landing page and product page we send paid traffic to, with its goal, audience, awareness level, offer, template, the ads that point to it, sessions, conversion and profit per visitor, and live or retired status. Holds the page blocks the store can build, so a new page is assembled from known parts.
inputs: ads with destination URLs and spend
GA4 sessions and conversions by landing page
powers: which pages to keep, fix or retire
a new page for a winning angle in days
no paid click sent to a sold-out or weak page

new_enablers.name: Test planner and reader
new_enablers.what: Scores test ideas on money at stake, evidence and traffic, sets sample size and run time in whole weeks before a test starts, and reads results on profit per visitor with a daily plot for novelty. For low traffic, gives an honest before and after read with the caveat printed.
inputs: a test tool or a theme split
powers: wins judged on profit, not conversion alone
